author: mark
text:
v0.3 wire types: tool_use / tool_result blocks + tools request field

Extend the provider-wire surface so a step can carry the model's
tool_use emissions and feed tool_result blocks back on the next step.
Both ContentBlock homes gain ToolUse / ToolResult variants; Anthropic
Request grows tools: Option<Vec<ToolDecl>> and Message.content becomes
polymorphic (string | block array). StepResponse replaces flat
assistant_response with structured content: Vec<ContentBlock> plus a
text() helper for the prose-only path. Pure wire/type ball — no loop
or executor changes; tests are serde round-trips against synthetic
payloads. Under the v0.3 tools epic (bl-683c).
